context: Merged lane/04-retrieval into foundation/v3 (no conflicts) and fixed a production defect it exposed: no adapter write path cited the membership policy, so every mirrored write on a store with a policy would have been quarantined.
rationale: ADR §4.3.1 states plainly that 'a membership must therefore be a causal ancestor of anything it authorizes', but no adapter path set parents at all: src/adapters/runtime.ts, v3-mirror.ts and event-factory.ts all left parents empty. On a store that has acquired a policy — which is every store after `twining identity init --human` runs the ceremony — every mirrored 2.x write (twining_post, twining_decide, twining_record) would have been quarantined no_policy_yet and never projected. Lane 03's own tests missed it because they run on policy-free stores. The producer is the one replica that always knows which policy applies, so citing it centrally in runtime.append is better than leaving each call site to remember. A caller-supplied parent list is extended, never replaced. The LATEST admitted membership is cited because an event is judged under the policy it names.
summary: Every event minted through the adapter runtime now cites this replica's current membership as a causal parent, via a new EventStore.currentPolicyEvent()
